sections: New
A new app icon: a Bed Wars island with a red bed. On macOS 26 it follows light and dark mode.
Changes
On macOS the Cobblify title sits under the window buttons, and moves up in full screen.
The stats board shows the Dev builds tag too.
Fixes
On macOS 26 the window and its buttons look like every other app's.
Windows shows the new icon in the taskbar and Start menu right after updating.
New
A new launcher, built like the in-game menu: one Launch button that remembers Lunar or Prism, and settings in a side sheet.
The stats board is drawn like Bed Wars' sidebar: one line per player, sized to your window.
What's New shows the changes once after each update.
The launcher follows the accent colour and font you picked in game.
Updates download by themselves until you turn Auto-update off.
Changes
The Minecraft font and Pale Blue are now the in-game default look.
Session Stats draws on top of everything; Session Stats and Map Info hide when you're not on Hypixel.
Seraph closed its API, so cheater tags now come from Urchin only.
New
Right Shift opens a new settings sheet, with search and 39 accent colours.
Edit HUD edits in place: snapping, corner resize, undo and a right-click menu.
A Minecraft font option for the menu and every HUD module.
Keystrokes shows clicks per second for both mouse buttons.
Fixes
On Lunar, Right Shift no longer opens and closes the menu at once.
Updates remove old Cobblify jars from Lunar and Prism.
Fixes
Lunar: the key that opens the settings sheet no longer closes it.
Fixes
Session Stats keeps counting after a disconnect.
Queue chat alerts trust only real queue messages.
